instruction: How to create a complete CA with openssl by generating a self-signed CA cert
output: openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -keyout ca-key.pem -out ca.pem -days 3650 -nodes -subj '/CN=My Root CA'

instruction: How to sign a server certificate with openssl ca using a generated CSR
output: openssl req -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout server-key.pem -out server.csr -nodes -subj '/CN=example.com' && openssl ca -batch -in server.csr -out server.pem -config /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf

instruction: How to generate a complete CA with CA cert, server cert, and client cert using certtool
output: certtool --generate-privkey --outfile ca-key.pem && certtool --generate-self-signed --load-privkey ca-key.pem --outfile ca.pem --template <(echo 'cn = Example CA') && certtool --generate-privkey --outfile server-key.pem && certtool --generate-request --load-privkey server-key.pem --outfile server.csr --template <(echo 'cn = example.com') && certtool --generate-certificate --load-request server.csr --load-ca-cert ca.pem --load-ca-privkey ca-key.pem --outfile server.pem --template <(echo 'cn = example.com')
